title: Subarrays with Exactly K Distinct Values
statement:
Given an array of positive integers and an integer K, count the number of contiguous subarrays that contain exactly K distinct values.

Use the identity: count(exactly K) = count(at most K) - count(at most K-1), where count(at most K) uses a sliding window.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated positive integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of subarrays with exactly K distinct values.

examples.explanation: Subarrays with exactly 2 distinct values: [1,2],[2,1],[1,2],[2,3],[1,2,1],[2,1,2],[1,2,1,2] — 7 total.
Every subarray has exactly 1 distinct value. C(4,2)+4 = 10.
